title: Breaking: The Fog Rolled In (Part 2)
description: Three weeks in, the fog is a permanent resident with a goose and a lawn chair. Snazzie FM carries the emergency town meeting live as the community debates whether the fog should pay rent, get a parking permit, and finally answer for the wind chimes.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Welcome back to Snazzie FM, where we are now in week three of having a weather system as a resident. Tonight we're carrying the emergency town meeting live. The fog is in attendance. So is the goose.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: A weather system cannot attend a meeting, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: It's in row four, Barry. It saved seats. <p:0.3> The agenda is one item. Does the fog pay rent.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: So I want to be clear, professionally, I no longer have instruments. The fog filled out a change of address form and the post office honored it. <p:0.3> It lives here now. The radar agrees.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: It still has my wind chimes, dear. <p:0.3> Three weeks. They're hanging in its yard now, and the yard is just more fog.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Noted for the record, Mildred. The chimes remain a sticking point. <p:0.3> Todd's on the floor at the meeting. Todd, what's the room like?

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Yeah, hi, Ronnie. So the fog took the podium. <p:0.3> It's not saying anything, it's just, occupying the podium, and the goose is doing the talking with a little wing motion. Like a lawyer.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: The goose is its lawyer.

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: The goose retained counsel, Barry, and the counsel is also the goose.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Okay can I just say, I tried to PARK this morning, and the fog had taken my spot, and there was a little permit in the window. <p:0.3> Resident parking. Issued to the fog.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: It got the permit. <p:0.3> Folks, that's a development. The fog is now legally parked.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: It's not just parked, Ronnie. The permit number is sequential. It's permit forty. <p:0.3> Which means it filed before thirty nine other people who have lived here their whole lives.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: It cut the line, dear! <p:0.3> The fog cut the LINE!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: How does fog stand in a line.

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Patiently, Barry. <p:0.3> Update. The fog just slid a check across the table. For rent. <p:0.4> It's, um. It's made of more fog. The check is fog.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: It's paying. <p:0.3> Folks, the tenant is paying rent. In fog. I'm upgrading our coverage. This is now a real estate transaction.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Don't take the check, Ronnie, if they take the check it's a LEASE, and if it's a lease we can't evict the fog, and the goose KNOWS that, look at the goose!

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: The town clerk just deposited it. <p:0.3> It cleared. <p:0.4> Ronnie, the fog has a bank account, and the balance is, the balance is also fog.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: Then it can AFFORD to give me my chimes back!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Mildred raises a fair point. <p:0.3> The fog is now solvent. It has no excuse. Todd, put it to the goose.

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: I asked the goose about the chimes. <p:0.3> The goose looked at me. Then it rang the chimes. ONCE. <p:0.4> Like a gavel.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: It overruled her with her own wind chimes.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Motion to evict!

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: Seconded!

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: It filed a counter motion!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Fog can't file!

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: It's notarized!

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: By WHO?!

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: The goose is a notary!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: The goose is a notary. <p:0.4> Folks. <p:0.3> The motion fails. The fog stays, the rent is paid, and the chimes belong to the yard now. <p:0.3> We are no longer classifying it as a tenant. We are classifying it as a homeowner.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: It only moved in three weeks ago.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: It put in an offer on the lot next door, Ronnie. <p:0.3> Cash. <p:0.4> Well. Fog.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Then we welcome the expansion. <p:0.3> The fog is buying the block, folks. We'll be right back, soon as the goose finishes the closing paperwork.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: Ask if the chimes convey with the property, dear.
